message: NOTIFY default taken while authoring the plan: elapsed/spend ceilings default to conservative built-in values, overridable via the project's calibration (rather than requiring owner configuration before first use). Required by FR-8 (ceilings in force without the owner setting anything) + unattended operation. Reversible — set the ceilings in calibration before the next run. Recorded in the plan's Key decisions & alternatives.

GATE-class blocker surfaced, NOT auto-decided: the deterministic completion-marker command as specified (front_half_usable.py --write-marker --root "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)") cannot stamp the marker for this OUT-OF-REPO project. Ran it exactly as instructed; it returned {"usable": false, "wrote": false}. Root cause (verified at front_half_usable.py line 57): the script hardcodes the in-repo layout base = <root>/docs/superheroes/<work-item>/, while this out-of-repo project's doc is written (mode-aware, via definition_doc.py resolve-write) to <store>/projects/8fa39520fa839af0/docs/<work-item>/plan.md — note NO 'superheroes' path segment. No --root value can reconcile the two schemes. The plan doc itself IS complete and content-usable: authored to the mode-correct location, all 8 required sections present as ## headings, no placeholders (missing_sections=[], placeholder=false); a synthetic in-repo-root proof shows front_half_usable --write-marker succeeds and --emit-signals returns usable:true with matching body hash a42902e943eb12d12bb7f32a4e3de34fa5644fe617b8b740a2b4747113642448. The blocker is the tooling gap (front_half_usable.py is not mode-aware, unlike definition_doc.py), not the authored content. The engine's own later usableDraft re-verify uses the same in-repo --root and will also miss the out-of-repo doc, so I did NOT fake or symlink-hack the marker into a location the engine won't read (that would be a false signal). Fix needed: make front_half_usable.py mode-aware (resolve via mode_registry.project_store_dir like definition_doc.py), or run the harness in in-repo mode for this project.
